# 07 - All-Solid-State Lithium-Metal Batteries

Acquisition method: Web research note synthesized from public sources.

Primary sources:

- IEA, Global EV Outlook 2025, Electric vehicle batteries: https://www.iea.org/reports/global-ev-outlook-2025/electric-vehicle-batteries
- Toyota and Idemitsu, all-solid-state battery cooperation: https://global.toyota/en/newsroom/corporate/39865919.html
- Toyota and Sumitomo Metal Mining, all-solid-state cathode materials: https://global.toyota/en/newsroom/corporate/43380876.html
- BMW and Solid Power, all-solid-state cells in BMW i7: https://www.press.bmwgroup.com/usa/article/detail/T0450262EN_US/bmw-group-and-solid-power-are-testing-all-solid-state-battery-cells-in-a-bmw-i7
- QuantumScape QSE-5 B1 samples: https://www.quantumscape.com/quantumscape-announces-shipment-of-b1-samples-achieving-a-key-annual-goal/
- QuantumScape and PowerCo Ducati demonstration: https://ir.quantumscape.com/resources/press-releases/news-details/2025/QuantumScape-and-PowerCo-Debut-Solid-State-Batteries-in-Ducati-Motorcycle-at-IAA-Mobility/default.aspx

## What It Is

All-solid-state batteries replace the liquid electrolyte with a solid electrolyte. Many EV-focused designs also use a lithium-metal anode or anode-free lithium-metal architecture to increase energy density.

## Automotive Relevance Today

All-solid-state is one of the most important future EV battery candidates, but not yet mainstream. IEA describes solid-state batteries as closer to commercial reality in 2024-2025, with large prototypes and manufacturing investments, but still around large pilot stage. Toyota, BMW/Solid Power, QuantumScape/PowerCo, Samsung SDI, Honda, and others are active.

## Strengths

Potential benefits include:

- Higher energy density.
- Faster charging.
- Better safety if flammable liquid electrolyte is removed.
- Longer life if interfaces are stable.
- Better packaging for premium and long-range vehicles.

Toyota says all-solid-state batteries could support longer driving range, shorter charging times, and higher output. BMW says the potential benefit is higher energy density in a compact storage system. QuantumScape frames its QSE-5 cells around energy density, charging speed, safety, lifespan, and cost-effectiveness.

## Weaknesses

The key barriers are scale, interfaces, manufacturing yield, cost, and validation. Solid electrolytes must maintain intimate contact with electrodes during cycling. Lithium metal can form dendrites or uneven deposits. Cell pressure, stack design, and durability under automotive conditions are hard problems.

IEA cautions that pack-scale advantages still need demonstration under controlled, realistic, standardized conditions.

## Commercialization Signals

Toyota and Idemitsu target commercialization in 2027-2028, followed by full-scale mass production later. Toyota and Sumitomo Metal Mining are developing cathode materials for BEV all-solid-state batteries.

BMW is testing large-format Solid Power all-solid-state cells in a BMW i7.

QuantumScape shipped B1 QSE-5 samples in 2025 and demonstrated QSE-5 cells in a Ducati motorcycle with PowerCo.

## Commercialization Outlook

First vehicle deployments by 2027-2028 are plausible, but broad mass-market impact is likely later. Initial volumes should be limited and probably premium or performance-focused. Cost competitiveness with mature lithium-ion may take several years after first launch.

## Implications for Older EV Value

All-solid-state is the technology most likely to change consumer expectations if it delivers dramatic range, charge, safety, and life improvements at scale. But the depreciation impact on current EVs before 2030 may be muted if early vehicles are expensive and low-volume.
